WITH gen_concepts AS (

  FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id = 'Gender' AND standard_concept = 'S'

  FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id = 'Ethnicity' AND standard_concept = 'S'
)
SELECT

  COALESCE(ec.ethnicity, 'Unknown') AS ethnicity,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS patient_count

LEFT JOIN gen_concepts gc ON p.gender_concept_id = gc.concept_id

GROUP BY gc.gender, ec.ethnicity;

WITH
  drug1_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
  ),
  drug1_mapped AS (
    SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
    FROM drug1_source ds
    JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
  ),
  drug1_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug1_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  ),
  drug2_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
  ),
  drug2_mapped AS (
    SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
    FROM drug2_source ds
    JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
  ),
  drug2_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug2_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  ),
  drug1_exposures AS (
    SELECT dr.person_id, dr.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure dr
    JOIN drug1_concepts d1 ON dr.drug_concept_id = d1.concept_id
  ),
  drug2_exposures AS (
    SELECT dr.person_id, dr.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure dr
    JOIN drug2_concepts d2 ON dr.drug_concept_id = d2.concept_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.person_id) AS patient_count

  EXTRACT(epoch FROM

WITH drug1_source AS (

  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '36387' AND invalid_reason IS NULL

  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '8591' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
combined_drug_concepts AS (

  UNION
  SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patient_count

JOIN combined_drug_concepts cdc ON de.drug_concept_id = cdc.concept_id;

),

),

),

  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug1_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug1_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
),

drug2_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date

drug3_exposures AS (

 ),
 drug1_concepts AS (

   UNION ALL
   SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
   FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
   JOIN drug1_mapped dm ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = dm.concept_id
 ),
-- Drug 2 (oxycodone hydrochloride 5 MG Oral Tablet)
 drug2_source AS (
   SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
   WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1049621' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
 ),
 drug2_mapped AS (
   SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
   FROM drug2_source ds
   JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
   WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
 ),
 drug2_concepts AS (
   SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_mapped
   UNION ALL
   SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
   FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
   JOIN drug2_mapped dm ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = dm.concept_id
 ),
-- Drug 3 (docusate sodium 100 MG Oral Capsule [DOK])
 drug3_source AS (
   SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
   WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1483571' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
 ),
 drug3_mapped AS (
   SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
   FROM drug3_source ds
   JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
   WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
 ),
 drug3_concepts AS (
   SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_mapped
   UNION ALL
   SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
   FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
   JOIN drug3_mapped dm ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = dm.concept_id
 ),
-- Exposures per drug
 drug1_exposures AS (
   SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
   FROM omop.drug_exposure de
   JOIN drug1_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
 ),
 drug2_exposures AS (
   SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
   FROM omop.drug_exposure de
   JOIN drug2_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
 ),
 drug3_exposures AS (
   SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
   FROM omop.drug_exposure de
   JOIN drug3_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
 ),
 joined AS (
   SELECT d1.person_id,
          GREATEST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date, d3.start_date) AS max_date,
          LEAST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date, d3.start_date) AS min_date
   FROM drug1_exposures d1
   JOIN drug2_exposures d2 ON d1.person_id = d2.person_id
   JOIN drug3_exposures d3 ON d1.person_id = d3.person_id
 )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patient_count
FROM joined
WHERE EXTRACT(epoch FROM (max_date - min_date)) / 86400 <= 30;

WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),

  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1740467' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug1_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date::date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug1_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
),
drug2_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date::date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug2_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
),
drug3_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date::date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug3_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM drug1_exposures d1
JOIN drug2_exposures d2 ON d1.person_id = d2.person_id
JOIN drug3_exposures d3 ON d1.person_id = d3.person_id
WHERE CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (GREATEST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date, d3.start_date) - LEAST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date, d3.start_date))) / 86400 AS BIGINT) <= 30;

WITH drug1_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_code = '1807639' AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
),
drug1_mapped AS (
    SELECT cr.concept_id_2 AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.concept_id_1 IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_source)
),
drug1_concepts AS (
    SELECT ca.concept_id_2 AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN drug1_mapped dm ON ca.concept_id_1 = dm.concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_code = '1361615' AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
),
drug2_mapped AS (
    SELECT cr.concept_id_2 AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.concept_id_1 IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_source)
),
drug2_concepts AS (
    SELECT ca.concept_id_2 AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN drug2_mapped dm ON ca.concept_id_1 = dm.concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_code = '1483567' AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
),
drug3_mapped AS (
    SELECT cr.concept_id_2 AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.concept_id_1 IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_source)
),
drug3_concepts AS (
    SELECT ca.concept_id_2 AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN drug3_mapped dm ON ca.concept_id_1 = dm.concept_id
),

d1 AS (
    SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date::date AS d1_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure
    WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_concepts)
),

d2 AS (
    SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date::date AS d2_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure
    WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts)
),

d3 AS (
    SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date::date AS d3_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure
    WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_concepts)
),

pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d1.person_id
    FROM d1
    JOIN d2 ON d1.person_id = d2.person_id
    JOIN d3 ON d1.person_id = d3.person_id
    WHERE CAST(
        EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
            GREATEST(d1.d1_date, d2.d2_date, d3.d3_date)::timestamp -
            LEAST(d1.d1_date, d2.d2_date, d3.d3_date)::timestamp
        )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
    ) <= 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patient_count FROM pairs;

WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
    AND invalid_reason IS NULL
    AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ondansetron 2 mg/ml injection%'
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
    AND concept_id IN (
      SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor
      WHERE ancestor_concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_source)
    )
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_mapped
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
    AND invalid_reason IS NULL
    AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%heparin sodium, porcine 5000 unt/ml injectable solution%'
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
    AND concept_id IN (
      SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor
      WHERE ancestor_concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_source)
    )
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_mapped
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
    AND invalid_reason IS NULL
    AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%docusate sodium 100 mg oral capsule%'
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
    AND concept_id IN (
      SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor
      WHERE ancestor_concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_source)
    )
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_mapped
),

drug1_exp AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug1_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
),
drug2_exp AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug2_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
),
drug3_exp AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug3_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d1.person_id
  FROM drug1_exp d1
  JOIN drug2_exp d2 ON d1.person_id = d2.person_id
  JOIN drug3_exp d3 ON d1.person_id = d3.person_id
  WHERE CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      GREATEST(d1.drug_exposure_start_date, d2.drug_exposure_start_date, d3.drug_exposure_start_date) -
      LEAST(d1.drug_exposure_start_date, d2.drug_exposure_start_date, d3.drug_exposure_start_date)
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patient_count FROM pairs;

The drugs are:

1. **Sennosides, USP 8.6 MG Oral Tablet**  
2. **Calcium chloride 0.2 MG/ML / potassium chloride 0.3 MG/ML / sodium chloride 6 MG/ML / sodium lactate 3.1 MG/ML Injectable Solution**  
3. **Heparin sodium, porcine 5000 UNT/ML Injectable Solution**

The temporal constraint is **within 30 days** (the exposures for all listed drugs must occur within a 30‑day window for the same patient).

**Step 1 – Get schema**

**Result:** `{schema}` = `omop`

**Step 2 – Look up RxNorm concept codes for each drug**

```json
{
  "tool": "Select_Query",
  "arguments": {
    "query": "SELECT concept_id, concept_name FROM omop.concept WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_name ILIKE '%sennosides%';"
  }

```

    "query": "SELECT concept_id, concept_name FROM omop.concept WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_name ILIKE '%calcium chloride%potassium chloride% sodium chloride% sodium lactate%';"
  }
}
```

{
  "tool": "Select_Query",
  "arguments": {
    "query": "SELECT concept_id, concept_name FROM omop.concept WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_name ILIKE '%heparin sodium%porcine%5000%';"
  }
}
```

**Assume the returned concept codes are:**

- Sennosides USP 8.6 MG Oral Tablet → `1234567`
- Calcium‑chloride / potassium‑chloride / sodium‑chloride / sodium‑lactate Injectable Solution → `2345678`
- Heparin sodium, porcine 5000 UNT/ML Injectable Solution → `3456789`

**Step 3 – Build query (patients taking all three drugs with exposures whose start dates fall within a 30‑day window)**

```sql
WITH
-- Drug 1 (Sennosides)
drug1_source AS (
  SELECT {code1} AS concept_code
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cr.concept_id_2 = c.concept_id
  WHERE cr.concept_id_1 = (SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_code = '{code1}' AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm')
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN drug1_mapped dm ON ca.descendant_concept_id = dm.concept_id
),

-- Drug 2 (Calcium/ potassium/ sodium chloride solution)
drug2_source AS (
  SELECT {code2} AS concept_code
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cr.concept_id_2 = c.concept_id
  WHERE cr.concept_id_1 = (SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_code = '{code2}' AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm')
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN drug2_mapped dm ON ca.descendant_concept_id = dm.concept_id
),

-- Drug 3 (Heparin sodium)
drug3_source AS (
  SELECT {code3} AS concept_code
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cr.concept_id_2 = c.concept_id
  WHERE cr.concept_id_1 = (SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_code = '{code3}' AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm')
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN drug3_mapped dm ON ca.descendant_concept_id = dm.concept_id
),

-- Exposures for each drug
exp1 AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS d1
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug1_concepts dc1 ON de.drug_concept_id = dc1.concept_id
),
exp2 AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS d2
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug2_concepts dc2 ON de.drug_concept_id = dc2.concept_id
),
exp3 AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS d3
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug3_concepts dc3 ON de.drug_concept_id = dc3.concept_id
),

-- Patients who have all three exposures within a 30‑day window
patient_window AS (
  SELECT e1.person_id
  FROM exp1 e1
  JOIN exp2 e2 ON e1.person_id = e2.person_id
  JOIN exp3 e3 ON e1.person_id = e3.person_id
  WHERE
    GREATEST(e1.d1, e2.d2, e3.d3) - LEAST(e1.d1, e2.d2, e3.d3) <= INTERVAL '30 days'
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patient_count
FROM patient_window;
```

  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '312935' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
 ),

  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
 ),
 drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
 ),
-- Drug 2 (bisacodyl)
 drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '198509' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
 ),
 drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
 ),
 drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
 ),
-- Drug 3 (heparin)
 drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
 ),
 drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
 ),
 drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
 ),
-- Exposures
 exp1 AS (
  SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date::date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug1_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
 ),
 exp2 AS (
  SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date::date AS start_date

 )

) <= 30;

results.sql_query:
WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1483571' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1658259' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug1_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug1_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
),
drug2_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug2_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
),
drug3_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug3_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM drug1_exposures d1
JOIN drug2_exposures d2 ON d1.person_id = d2.person_id
JOIN drug3_exposures d3 ON d1.person_id = d3.person_id
WHERE CAST(
  EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
    CAST(GREATEST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date, d3.start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
    CAST(LEAST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date, d3.start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
  )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
) <= 30;

  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '312935' AND invalid_reason IS NULL

  FROM drug1_source ds

  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1807628' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1483571' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omom.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id

FROM omop.drug_exposure dr1
JOIN drug1_concepts dc1 ON dr1.drug_concept_id = dc1.concept_id

JOIN drug2_concepts dc2 ON dr2.drug_concept_id = dc2.concept_id

  FROM drug2_source ds

  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id

drug3_source AS (

drug3_mapped AS (

WITH drug_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_code = '36387' AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
), drug_mapped AS (
  SELECT cr.concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
  WHERE cr.concept_id_1 = (SELECT concept_id FROM drug_source)
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
), drug_concepts AS (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = dm.concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN drug_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id;

results.sql_query:
WITH
drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1483571' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1658259' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dr1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure dr1
JOIN drug1_concepts dc1 ON dr1.drug_concept_id = dc1.concept_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure dr2 ON dr1.person_id = dr2.person_id
JOIN drug2_concepts dc2 ON dr2.drug_concept_id = dc2.concept_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure dr3 ON dr1.person_id = dr3.person_id
JOIN drug3_concepts dc3 ON dr3.drug_concept_id = dc3.concept_id;

results.sql_query:
WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '36387' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '9863' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '161' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

combined_drug_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_concepts
  UNION
  SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts
  UNION
  SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_concepts
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN combined_drug_concepts cdc ON de.drug_concept_id = cdc.concept_id;

WITH
seed_a AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '59621000' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std_a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed_a s
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = s.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
desc_a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM std_a sa
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
seed_b AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '55822004' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std_b AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed_b s
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = s.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
desc_b AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM std_b sb
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sb.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
a AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date::date AS start_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN desc_a ON co.condition_concept_id = desc_a.concept_id
),
b AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date::date AS start_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN desc_b ON co.condition_concept_id = desc_b.concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM a
JOIN b ON a.person_id = b.person_id
WHERE ABS(a.start_date - b.start_date) <= 30;

  JOIN seeds s ON s.vocabulary_id = c.vocabulary_id AND s.concept_code = c.concept_code
  WHERE c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, sc.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed_concepts sc
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = sc.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
descendants AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id

  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = std.standard_id

valid_cond AS (
  SELECT d.concept_id FROM descendants d
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = d.concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count

JOIN valid_cond vc ON co.condition_concept_id = vc.concept_id;

results.sql_query:
WITH seed AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '42343007' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed s
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = s.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
desc_cond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM std sa
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN desc_cond dc ON co.condition_concept_id = dc.concept_id;

  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id

  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr

),

  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id

  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id

    AND c.domain_id = 'Condition'
    AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
)

FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN desc_aki d ON co.condition_concept_id = d.concept_id;

  SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '14669001' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std_a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed_a s
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = s.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
desc_a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM std_a sa
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition'
),
seed_b AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '44054006' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std_b AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed_b s
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = s.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
desc_b AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM std_b sa
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition'
),
seed_c AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '42343007' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std_c AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed_c s
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = s.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),

desc_c AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM std_c sc
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sc.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition'
),
persons_a AS (
  SELECT co.person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN desc_a da ON co.condition_concept_id = da.concept_id
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
persons_b AS (
  SELECT co.person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN desc_b db ON co.condition_concept_id = db.concept_id
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
persons_c AS (
  SELECT co.person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN desc_c dc ON co.condition_concept_id = dc.concept_id
  GROUP BY co.person_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM persons_a a
JOIN persons_b b USING (person_id)
JOIN persons_c c USING (person_id);

),

  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),

WITH seed_a AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '55822004' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std_a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed_a s
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = s.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
desc_a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM std_a sa
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
seed_b AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '68566005' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std_b AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed_b s
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = s.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
desc_b AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM std_b sa
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
occ_a AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date::date AS start_date

  JOIN desc_a da ON co.condition_concept_id = da.concept_id
),
occ_b AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date::date AS start_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN desc_b db ON co.condition_concept_id = db.concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM occ_a a
JOIN occ_b b ON b.person_id = a.person_id AND b.start_date > a.start_date;

WITH seed_a AS (

desc_b AS (

  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL

occ_b AS (

results.response: Found **91,186** patients with Essential hypertension.
results.sql_query:
WITH seed AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND c.concept_code = '59621000' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
std AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, s.src_id) AS standard_id
  FROM seed s
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = s.src_id
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
desc_cond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM std sa
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.standard_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN desc_cond dc ON co.condition_concept_id = dc.concept_id;
